environment.displayModeHint: Changes how the scene is drawn, never what it holds
environment.preset_neutralHint: Plain grey and no grading, for judging the colour of a material as it is
environment.preset_studioHint: Workshop light on a dark backdrop, for showing a model
environment.preset_productHint: Light backdrop and white ground, like a catalogue photograph
environment.preset_outdoorHint: The project’s sky behind the scene, with haze to give it distance
environment.preset_nightHint: A dark setting, with the exposure opened to make up for it
environment.presetHint: Sets the light, the backdrop and the render in one go. What a look does not mention is left alone
environment.source_studioHint: A lit room the studio builds itself, with no image to load
environment.source_skyboxHint: An image of the project lights the scene and fills its reflections, as it is
environment.source_skyHint: The scene follows a sky document: its graded image, its sun and its intensity — editing that sky edits the scene
environment.rotationHint: Turns the sky about the vertical, reflections and all
environment.background_environmentHint: Shows the sky behind the scene, or the studio colour when there is none
environment.background_colorHint: A plain colour behind the scene. The sky goes on lighting it without being seen
environment.background_transparentHint: Nothing behind the scene, so the image can be laid over something else
environment.groundVisibleHint: A real plane under the scene that catches shadows — not to be confused with the grid
environment.gridVisibleHint: A working landmark, never drawn into a render or into an edit
environment.boundingBoxesHint: The volume each object takes up, for judging how much room it needs
environment.visibility_offHint: Keeps the view clean, with none of these aids drawn
environment.visibility_selectedHint: On what is chosen alone, the default that keeps the view readable
environment.visibility_allHint: On every object, which reads well on a small scene and crowds a large one
environment.skeletonsHint: Shows the bone structure used to animate rigged models
environment.originsHint: The axes an object carries, at the point it turns around
environment.normalsHint: Which way each surface faces, on the chosen object
environment.snapEnabledHint: Moves in steps rather than continuously
environment.shadows_offHint: No shadows worked out at all, which is the cheapest setting there is
environment.shadows_fastHint: Hard edges on a small map, quick but a little jagged
environment.shadows_standardHint: Softened edges, the right trade for working
environment.shadows_highHint: The finest map, worth keeping for large scenes lit from far away
environment.shadowsCustomHint: The fine shadow settings match none of these levels
environment.shadowsCappedHint: The viewport quality is holding the shadows below the level asked for
environment.fog_linearHint: Fades between two distances you choose
environment.fog_exp2Hint: Thickens with distance, the way real haze does
environment.tone_noneHint: No conversion, which is what the studio has always shown
environment.tone_linearHint: A plain conversion, with no roll-off on the highlights
environment.tone_reinhardHint: Brings highlights down gently, for a flatter image
environment.tone_cineonHint: A curve taken from film stock, with more contrast
environment.tone_acesHint: The digital cinema curve, the one that keeps a highlight from clipping to pure white
environment.quality_performanceHint: Fewer pixels worked out and shadows capped, for large scenes
environment.quality_balancedHint: The default, and right nearly everywhere
environment.quality_highHint: Everything the screen can show, with no cap on the shadows
environment.unit_mmHint: Writes and reads lengths in millimetres
environment.unit_cmHint: Writes and reads lengths in centimetres
environment.unit_mHint: Writes and reads lengths in metres, which is what one scene unit is
environment.statsHint: Counts the triangles, vertices and draw calls in the corner of the view
